study_name.notes: No canonical study identifier (e.g., AuthorX_YYYY) was reported in the text.

subject_id.notes: No individual subject identifiers were provided in the available text; only aggregate group-level statistics (n=77 AN, n=70 HC) are reported.

sample_id.notes: No unique sample identifiers were given in the text; sample counts (n=147 total) are reported without per-sample IDs.

pmid.notes: The paper_id 37069399 was supplied as metadata but no PMID citation appears within the extracted paper text.

subcohort.evidence_quote: AN-RS type cases were characterized by higher values of serum insulin and lower insulin sensitivity than AN-BP individuals
subcohort.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
subcohort.notes: AN-RS and AN-BP subtypes are described as clinical subcohorts of AN cases, but this field was not populated per main AN/HC subgroup structure to avoid conflating with the primary case/control grouping.

target_condition.evidence_quote: Anorexia nervosa (AN) is an eating disorder with a high mortality.

control.evidence_quote: a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females

country.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark from 1 September 2014 to 31 July 2016

body_site.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples, respectively
body_site.notes: Serum was also collected for metabolomics but body_site enum applies to the gut microbiome sample type (feces).

location.value: Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital, Denmark
location.evidence_quote: Center for Eating Disorders (Odense University Hospital), Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Unit (Aarhus University Hospital) and Unit for Psychiatric Research (Aalborg University Hospital)

westernized.notes: Not explicitly stated, though Danish cohort likely westernized; left as not_reported to avoid inference.

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_exclusion_period.notes: Same exclusion criterion (antibiotics within last 3 months) also applied to control participants.

antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.evidence_quote: antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: DNA extraction from aliquots of faecal samples was performed following IHMS SOP P7 V2
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Faecal sample collection and DNA extraction
dna_extraction_kit.notes: A standardized IHMS protocol was used for human faecal DNA extraction rather than a named commercial kit matching the allowed enum values; NucleoSpin soil mini kit was used only for mouse 16S rRNA sequencing.

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: Purified and amplified DNA fragment libraries were sequenced using the Ion Proton Sequencer (Thermo Fisher)

age.notes: Cohort mean/median age is referenced as being in Supplementary Table 1/2, but exact values are not printed in the provided text.

ancestry.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases
ancestry.notes: Ancestry restriction stated explicitly for AN cases; assumed to also apply to age-matched Danish controls though not explicitly repeated.

ancestry_details.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases

sex.evidence_quote: we decided to include only women in the present study

zigosity.notes: Twin studies mentioned only as background on heritability, not describing participant zygosity.

age_min.notes: Aggregate age range for the AN/HC cohort is reported in Supplementary Tables 1/2, which were not included in the provided text.

age_max.notes: Same as age_min; not available in provided main text.

age_years.notes: Cohort-level mean age not given in provided text (see Supplementary Table 1/2). Individual ages are reported only for the 6 FMT donor participants (see samples array).

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Inferred from exclusion criteria that enrolled participants (both AN and HC) had not used antibiotics within 3 months prior to enrollment; does not directly confirm status at sampling time.

bmi.evidence_quote: the exclusion criteria for the age-matched healthy control women were BMI below 18.5 or above 25 kg m 21 −2
bmi.notes: This is an inclusion/exclusion criterion range for HC group, not a measured mean BMI value; actual cohort BMI values are in Supplementary Table 1/2 (not provided). Individual BMI values are reported for the 6 FMT donors (see samples array).

dietary_restriction.notes: Structured refeeding/macronutrient composition described for AN inpatient/outpatient treatment, but not clearly matching a 'dietary restriction' SNOMED term for participant phenotype.

disease.evidence_quote: a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females

disease_details.evidence_quote: the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type

feces_phenotype.evidence_quote: Stools were collected according to International Human Microbiome Standards (IHMS) guidelines
feces_phenotype.section: Methods — Faecal sample collection and DNA extraction
feces_phenotype.notes: No specific clinical stool phenotype (e.g., consistency, calprotectin) reported; only that fecal specimens were collected for metagenomics.

fmt_id.notes: Only group-level labels 'AN-T' and 'HC-T' are used for mouse recipient groups; no individual donor/recipient IDs reported.

fmt_role.evidence_quote: we transplanted faecal microbiota from three randomly chosen AN-RS cases ... and three age-matched HC participants to three independent litters of female germ-free (GF) mice
fmt_role.section: Results — Gut microbiota induces reduced weight gain and altered energy metabolism in mice

obgyn_birth_control.evidence_quote: regular medication of any kind apart from birth control pills
obgyn_birth_control.notes: Only mentions birth control pills as an allowed exception to medication exclusion for HC group; does not confirm actual current use status per participant.

smoker.evidence_quote: covariates including age, BMI, smoking and multiple drug intake were corrected
smoker.section: Results — Gut microbiota composition is altered in AN
smoker.notes: Smoking status/history was collected as a covariate but exact classification per participant is not reported in provided text (likely in Supplementary Table 2).

treatment.evidence_quote: Medication included selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors, antipsychotics and benzodiazepines.
treatment.notes: AN patients were also enrolled in cognitive behavioural therapeutic treatment courses (outpatient) and specialized multidisciplinary treatment (inpatient), but these are broader care descriptions rather than specific medications.

biomarker_name.notes: Paper reports qualitative differences (e.g., glucose, insulin, CRP, HOMA-IR) but no explicit paired biomarker name/unit/value lists are provided in the extracted text; detailed values are in Supplementary Tables 1-2 not included.

biomarker_unit.notes: No explicit units given for biomarkers in main text.

biomarker_value.notes: No explicit numeric biomarker values reported in the extracted text.

disease_response_os.notes: Study does not report overall survival; mortality rate is mentioned generally but not as an OS duration metric for the cohort.

ecog_performance_status.notes: Not an oncology study; ECOG performance status is not applicable/reported.

feces_phenotype_value.notes: No corresponding 'feces_phenotype' field or values explicitly defined in the text.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Study is unrelated to tumor/cancer measurements.

value: AN cohort: 77 females with anorexia nervosa; HC cohort: 70 age-matched healthy females; Danish Caucasian women recruited 2014-2016
FMT experiments used 3 AN-RS donors and 3 HC donors transplanted into female germ-free Swiss Webster mice
AN subtypes: AN-RS (n=56) restricting type and AN-BP (n=21) binge-eating/purging type
Mortality rate for AN estimated at 5.6% per decade
uncurated_metadata.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples, respectively, from a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females.
uncurated_metadata.notes: General cohort/study design metadata not captured by other schema fields.

host_species.evidence_quote: 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females
host_species.notes: Study also includes a mouse model (female germ-free Swiss Webster mice) used for faecal microbiota transplantation experiments, but the primary human cohort is the focus of most extracted data; mice are a secondary host species used in vivo.

extraction_warnings: The paper reports aggregate/group-level statistics (77 AN cases, 70 HC controls) rather than individual subject/sample identifiers; true sample-level rows could not be constructed without fabricating IDs.

Supplementary Tables 1 and 2, which contain detailed baseline characteristics including age and BMI, are referenced but their numeric contents are not printed in the provided text, so many demographic fields (age, BMI-related) are marked not_reported.

Individual donor data for the mouse FMT experiment (3 AN patients aged 20,22,20 yr with BMI 10.3,11.5,11.7; 3 HC aged 20,22,21 yr with BMI 22.6,21.1,21.2) constitute near sample-level information, but lack explicit subject/sample IDs, so they were not converted into sample-level rows to avoid fabricating identifiers.
subcohort field ambiguous: AN-RS/AN-BP subtypes exist as clinical subcohorts within the AN group, but were not mapped to the primary AN/HC subgroup structure used for this extraction.
DNA extraction kit for human fecal samples used a standardized IHMS protocol (SOP P7 V2), not a named commercial kit matching the provided enum list.
Batch 1 returned granularity='sample_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 1 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['AN', 'HC']; kept batch 0.

Detailed cohort demographic tables (Supplementary Tables 1 and 2) were referenced but not included in the provided text, limiting extraction of aggregate age, BMI, and smoking status for the full 77 AN / 70 HC cohort.
Sample-level data (age, BMI, disease group, FMT role) were only explicitly available for the 6 human donors used in the mouse FMT experiment; these were extracted as sample-level rows.

Several fields (dietary_restriction, obgyn_birth_control, feces_phenotype, fmt_id) had ambiguous or indirect textual support and were marked not_reported or low-confidence to avoid overinterpretation.
Antibiotics current use and birth control status were inferred from exclusion criteria rather than directly stated as participant-level measurements.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['AN', 'HC']; kept batch 0.
This paper is an anorexia nervosa gut microbiota study, not an oncology study; fields related to tumor size, ECOG status, and overall survival are not applicable and were marked not_reported.

Detailed biomarker values (glucose, insulin, CRP, HOMA-IR) are referenced qualitatively in the main text but exact numeric values are located in Supplementary Tables 1-2, which were not included in the provided text, so biomarker_name/unit/value fields could not be populated with specific numbers.

Two host species are involved (human participants and germ-free mice used for FMT experiments); the schema only allows a single string value, so 'Homo sapiens' was chosen as primary with mouse use noted in the field's notes.
